C0683.title: Cloud Drive Piracy for Profit Case
C0683.summary: The defendant Chang built a website that used crawlers to scrape massive cloud drive links to infringing films, software, and courses, profiting through membership fees and ad revenue sharing. By the time of the case, the site had indexed over 3,000 infringing works, registered 69,000 members, and generated over 2 million yuan in illegal revenue. The court convicted Chang of copyright infringement
